title: GPT 6 Astra vs Fable 5.1
author: Independent-Arm-7397
selftext:
I tried the same one-prompt Tokyo batting game with GPT-6 Astra and Fable 5.1 on Rezona   
  
Same idea, two very different generations.  
  
\- GPT-6 Astra got the core mechanics working immediately, with responsive batting, clean pitch timing and a surprisingly polished neon environment.  
  
\- Fable 5.1 leaned a little more into the cinematic side while still producing a solid playable result.  
  
What stood out to me was the iteration cost. In this run, Astra used fewer credits while still getting very close to the result I wanted on the first generation, which gives you more room to experiment without burning through the budget as quickly.  
  
Both did a genuinely good job here.
